baseline_facts.content: Patient has had diarrhea for the past three days.
Patient is having bowel movements 5 to 6 times per day.
Patient vomited a couple of times at the beginning of the illness.
Patient has eaten little solid food.
Patient felt a bit of temperature at the beginning of the illness.
Patient currently does not feel feverish.
No recent takeaway or restaurant food reported.
No known contact with anyone with diarrhea in the last week or so.
Patient uses a blue inhaler infrequently.
Family history: father had high blood pressure.
Family history: father died of bowel cancer ten years ago.
Family history: mother has type 2 diabetes.
Patient has taken time off work for the last three days due to illness.
Doctor advised patient to drink plenty of fluids.
Doctor recommended oral rehydration solution Dioralyte.
Doctor advised patient may take Paracetamol if feeling feverish and weak.
Doctor advised taking the next day or two off work.
Doctor advised to return to work after being diarrhea-free for about twenty four to forty eight hours.
Doctor advised follow-up next week if not better.
